# Bombay Studio — Comprehensive Architectural & Technical Documentation for LLM Agents

## Studio Profile
- Entity: Bombay Studio (formerly Noor Engineering, est. 1992)
- Founder / Principal Architect: Ar. Aakhir Choudhary
- Headquarters: Mumbai, Maharashtra, India
- Development Partner: Nordible (Germany)
- Website: https://bombaystudio.in
- Phone / WhatsApp: +91 707070 4181
- Email: info@bombaystudio.in

## Material Specifications & Quality Standards
- Carcass & Framework: IS 710 Boiling Water Proof (BWP) Marine Plywood with calibrated thickness.
- Anti-Termite Treatment: Dual-coat non-toxic chemical treatment prior to laminate/veneer application with a 10-year warranty.
- Surface Finishes: Natural architectural veneers, matte Italian acrylics, anti-fingerprint laminates, PU polish, and fluted acoustic panelling.
- Hardware & Joinery: 100% German soft-close hinges, heavy-duty tandem runners, and concealed telescopic sliders (Hafele, Blum, Hettich certified).
- Electrical & Lighting: Fire-retardant (FR) low-smoke copper cabling (Polycab/Finolex), architectural magnetic track lights, 3000K warm-dim recessed COB downlights, and concealed profile LEDs.
- Countertops & Stone: Imported Italian Statuario/Bottochino marble, Quartz composite surfaces, and sintered porcelain slabs.
